assignments.description:
Sets outSummaryHtml += "


Outcomes not linked to a Strategy

"; varUnlinkedHeaderAdded = true.
assignments.name: asgAppendUnlinkedHeader
assignments.label: Append Unlinked Outcomes Header

assignments.description: Clears varActivityTargetLabel before the target is looked up.
assignments.name: asgResetActivityLabel
assignments.label: Reset Activity Target Label

decisions.description: After {!loopGoals} has finished: if a matching goal name was found, adds the goal activity line; otherwise adds the activity without a target.
decisions.name: decGoalLabelFound
decisions.label: Goal Label Found?

decisions.description: After {!loopBenefits} has finished: if a matching benefit name was found, adds the benefit activity line; otherwise adds the activity without a target.
decisions.name: decBenefitLabelFound
decisions.label: Benefit Label Found?

decisions.description: After {!loopPrograms} has finished: if a matching program name was found, adds the program activity line; otherwise adds the activity without a target.
decisions.name: decProgramLabelFound
decisions.label: Program Label Found?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Unlinked Outcome" when varRenderingUnlinked = true -> loopUnlinkedOutcomes; "Strategy Outcome" otherwise -> loopOutcomesForAssignment.
decisions.name: decActivityContext
decisions.label: Activity Rendering Context

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when loopActivitiesForOutcome.OutcomeId = {!varCurrentOutcome.Id} -> asgResetActivityLabel; "No" otherwise -> loopActivitiesForOutcome.
decisions.name: decActivityMatchesOutcome
decisions.label: Activity Matches Outcome?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Program" when loopActivitiesForOutcome.ProgramId is null false -> loopPrograms; "Benefit" when loopActivitiesForOutcome.BenefitId is null false -> loopBenefits; "Goal" when loopActivitiesForOutcome.GoalDefinitionId is null false -> loopGoals; "No Target" otherwise -> asgAppendPlainActivity.
decisions.name: decActivityTargetType
decisions.label: Activity Target Type

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when loopAssignmentsForStrategy.ImpactStrategyId = {!loopStrategies.Id} -> loopOutcomesForAssignment; "No" otherwise -> loopAssignmentsForStrategy.
decisions.name: decAssignmentMatchesStrategy
decisions.label: Assignment Matches Strategy?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when loopBenefits.Id = {!loopActivitiesForOutcome.BenefitId} -> asgSetBenefitLabel; "No" otherwise -> loopBenefits.
decisions.name: decBenefitMatches
decisions.label: Benefit Matches?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Program" when loopCollectActivities.ProgramId is null false -> decCollectProgramId; "Benefit" when loopCollectActivities.BenefitId is null false -> decCollectBenefitId; "Goal" when loopCollectActivities.GoalDefinitionId is null false -> decCollectGoalId; "No Target" otherwise -> loopCollectActivities.
decisions.name: decCollectActivityTarget
decisions.label: Collect Activity Target ID

decisions.description: Routes on: "Already Collected" when colBenefitIds contains {!loopCollectActivities.BenefitId} -> loopCollectActivities; "Collect" otherwise -> asgCollectBenefitId.
decisions.name: decCollectBenefitId
decisions.label: Benefit ID Already Collected?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Already Collected" when colGoalIds contains {!loopCollectActivities.GoalDefinitionId} -> loopCollectActivities; "Collect" otherwise -> asgCollectGoalId.
decisions.name: decCollectGoalId
decisions.label: Goal ID Already Collected?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Already Collected" when colProgramIds contains {!loopCollectActivities.ProgramId} -> loopCollectActivities; "Collect" otherwise -> asgCollectProgramId.
decisions.name: decCollectProgramId
decisions.label: Program ID Already Collected?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Already Collected" when colStrategyIds contains {!loopCollectAssignments.ImpactStrategyId} -> loopCollectAssignments; "Collect" otherwise -> asgCollectAssignmentIds.
decisions.name: decCollectStrategyId
decisions.label: Strategy ID Already Collected?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when loopGoals.Id = {!loopActivitiesForOutcome.GoalDefinitionId} -> asgSetGoalLabel; "No" otherwise -> loopGoals.
decisions.name: decGoalMatches
decisions.label: Goal Matches?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Has Activities" when inActivityIds is null false -> getActivities; "No Activities" otherwise -> decHaveAssignmentsToCollect.
decisions.name: decHasActivityIds
decisions.label: Activity IDs Supplied?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Has Assignments" when inAssignmentIds is null false -> getAssignments; "No Assignments" otherwise -> decHasOutcomeIds.
decisions.name: decHasAssignmentIds
decisions.label: Assignment IDs Supplied?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when colBenefitIds is null false -> getBenefits; "No" otherwise -> decHasGoalLabels.
decisions.name: decHasBenefitLabels
decisions.label: Benefit Labels Required?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when colGoalIds is null false -> getGoals; "No" otherwise -> decHaveStrategiesToRender.
decisions.name: decHasGoalLabels
decisions.label: Goal Labels Required?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Has Outcomes" when inOutcomeIds is null false -> getOutcomes; "No Outcomes" otherwise -> decHasActivityIds.
decisions.name: decHasOutcomeIds
decisions.label: Outcome IDs Supplied?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when colProgramIds is null false -> getPrograms; "No" otherwise -> decHasBenefitLabels.
decisions.name: decHasProgramLabels
decisions.label: Program Labels Required?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when colStrategyIds is null false -> getStrategies; "No" otherwise -> decHasProgramLabels.
decisions.name: decHasStrategyLabels
decisions.label: Strategy Labels Required?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when colActivities is null false -> loopCollectActivities; "No" otherwise -> decHasStrategyLabels.
decisions.name: decHaveActivitiesToCollect
decisions.label: Activities Loaded?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when colAssignments is null false -> loopCollectAssignments; "No" otherwise -> decHaveActivitiesToCollect.
decisions.name: decHaveAssignmentsToCollect
decisions.label: Assignments Loaded?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Render Strategies" when colStrategies is null false -> loopStrategies; "No Strategies" otherwise -> loopUnlinkedOutcomes.
decisions.name: decHaveStrategiesToRender
decisions.label: Strategies Loaded?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Linked" when colLinkedOutcomeIds contains {!loopUnlinkedOutcomes.Id} -> loopUnlinkedOutcomes; "Unlinked" otherwise -> decUnlinkedHeaderAdded.
decisions.name: decOutcomeIsLinked
decisions.label: Outcome Linked?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when loopOutcomesForAssignment.Id = {!loopAssignmentsForStrategy.OutcomeId} -> asgSetOutcome; "No" otherwise -> loopOutcomesForAssignment.
decisions.name: decOutcomeMatchesAssignment
decisions.label: Outcome Matches Assignment?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when loopPrograms.Id = {!loopActivitiesForOutcome.ProgramId} -> asgSetProgramLabel; "No" otherwise -> loopPrograms.
decisions.name: decProgramMatches
decisions.label: Program Matches?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes" when varUnlinkedHeaderAdded = true -> asgAppendUnlinkedOutcome; "No" otherwise -> asgAppendUnlinkedHeader.
decisions.name: decUnlinkedHeaderAdded
decisions.label: Unlinked Header Added?

Flow.description: Builds the user-facing Strategy, Outcome and Activity hierarchy using constant-count queries and nested in-memory matching.
Flow.label: Subflow: Outcome Strategy - Build Session Summary

loops.description: Iterates over {!colActivities} (Asc order); each item is sent to decActivityMatchesOutcome, and once exhausted the loop exits to decActivityContext.
loops.name: loopActivitiesForOutcome
loops.label: Match Activities To Outcome

loops.description: Iterates over {!colAssignments} (Asc order); each item is sent to decAssignmentMatchesStrategy, and once exhausted the loop exits to loopStrategies.
loops.name: loopAssignmentsForStrategy
loops.label: Match Assignments To Strategy

loops.description: Iterates over {!colBenefits} (Asc order); each item is sent to decBenefitMatches, and once exhausted the loop exits to decBenefitLabelFound. The loop always runs to the end so that it starts from the first item for the next activity.
loops.name: loopBenefits
loops.label: Resolve Benefit Label

loops.description: Iterates over {!colActivities} (Asc order); each item is sent to decCollectActivityTarget, and once exhausted the loop exits to decHasStrategyLabels.
loops.name: loopCollectActivities
loops.label: Collect Activity Target IDs

loops.description: Iterates over {!colAssignments} (Asc order); each item is sent to asgCollectLinkedOutcomeId, and once exhausted the loop exits to decHaveActivitiesToCollect.
loops.name: loopCollectAssignments
loops.label: Collect Assignment IDs

loops.description: Iterates over {!colGoals} (Asc order); each item is sent to decGoalMatches, and once exhausted the loop exits to decGoalLabelFound. The loop always runs to the end so that it starts from the first item for the next activity.
loops.name: loopGoals
loops.label: Resolve Goal Label

loops.description: Iterates over {!colOutcomes} (Asc order); each item is sent to decOutcomeMatchesAssignment, and once exhausted the loop exits to loopAssignmentsForStrategy.
loops.name: loopOutcomesForAssignment
loops.label: Match Outcomes To Assignment

loops.description: Iterates over {!colPrograms} (Asc order); each item is sent to decProgramMatches, and once exhausted the loop exits to decProgramLabelFound. The loop always runs to the end so that it starts from the first item for the next activity.
loops.name: loopPrograms
loops.label: Resolve Program Label

loops.description: Iterates over {!colStrategies} (Asc order); each item is sent to asgAppendStrategy, and once exhausted the loop exits to loopUnlinkedOutcomes.
loops.name: loopStrategies
loops.label: Loop Strategies

loops.description: Iterates over {!colOutcomes} (Asc order); each item is sent to decOutcomeIsLinked, and once exhausted the loop exits to None.
loops.name: loopUnlinkedOutcomes
loops.label: Loop Unlinked Outcomes

recordLookups.description: Query OutcomeActivity for all matching records where Id in {!inActivityIds}. Retrieves Id, Name, OutcomeId, ProgramId, BenefitId, GoalDefinitionId. On failure, routes to asgSetLookupError.
recordLookups.name: getActivities
recordLookups.label: Get Session Activities

recordLookups.description: Query ImpactStrategyAssignment for all matching records where Id in {!inAssignmentIds}. Retrieves Id, ImpactStrategyId, OutcomeId. On failure, routes to asgSetLookupError.
recordLookups.name: getAssignments
recordLookups.label: Get Session Strategy Assignments

recordLookups.description: Query Benefit for all matching records where Id in {!colBenefitIds}. Retrieves Id, Name. On failure, routes to asgSetLookupError.
recordLookups.name: getBenefits
recordLookups.label: Get Benefit Labels

recordLookups.description: Query GoalDefinition for all matching records where Id in {!colGoalIds}. Retrieves Id, Name. On failure, routes to asgSetLookupError.
recordLookups.name: getGoals
recordLookups.label: Get Goal Definition Labels

recordLookups.description: Query Outcome for all matching records where Id in {!inOutcomeIds}. Retrieves Id, Name, IntendedDirection, Term. On failure, routes to asgSetLookupError.
recordLookups.name: getOutcomes
recordLookups.label: Get Session Outcomes

recordLookups.description: Query Program for all matching records where Id in {!colProgramIds}. Retrieves Id, Name. On failure, routes to asgSetLookupError.
recordLookups.name: getPrograms
recordLookups.label: Get Program Labels

recordLookups.description: Query ImpactStrategy for all matching records where Id in {!colStrategyIds}. Retrieves Id, Name. On failure, routes to asgSetLookupError.
recordLookups.name: getStrategies
recordLookups.label: Get Strategy Labels
